name: Northwind account sketch
status: Design only: no onboarded Forma prelude; syntax and journeys unverified.

statusLegend.built: Supported by the separate TypeScript account DSL described in the supplied sketch; not implemented by a Forma prelude in this package.
statusLegend.proposed: A design proposal, not built in either language in the supplied context.
statusLegend.unsupported: A resource that the supplied sketch says today’s platform adapter cannot support.

sections.title: Package & types
sections.resource: package manifest + external form reference + choice vocabulary
sections.summary: The package sets a key namespace, requires the compliance library’s W-4 by reference, and declares closed choice vocabularies.
sections.note: Declarations and their imports would form the package. Proposed citations and clauses would attach provenance to resource specs; that resource format is separate from this package’s OntologyIR.
sections.source:
(package northwind
  :version "0.1.0"
  :publisher :organization)

; [built] Account.requires. A form another package provides, referenced by key, never copied.
; prelude: (Declares FormDef) bound to an external { kind: "form", key } reference. :check
;          that the key is outside this package's namespace.
(require-form w4 "irs.w-4" :from "onboarded.compliance")

(choice UnionLocal {:local_42 "Local 42" :local_77 "Local 77" :none "Not represented"})
(choice SiteType   {:warehouse "Warehouse" :office "Office"})
(choice Region     {:west "West" :east "East"})
(choice CertificationKind {:forklift "Forklift"})

sections.title: Properties
sections.summary: Extend existing domain entities with typed, stable attribute paths. Permission scope is explicit on Client.region.
sections.note: Proposed derive and entity declarations go further: union_covered would be inlined when read; Certification is also marked unsupported by the adapter.
sections.source:
(extend Client
  {:region               (Enum Region :label "Region" :permission-scope true)
   :requires_drug_screen (Boolean :label "Requires drug screen")})

(extend Job
  {:site_type   (Enum SiteType :label "Site type" :searchable true)
   :hourly_rate (Decimal :label "Hourly rate")})

sections.title: Extensions
sections.summary: A union_covered attribute derives a rule from union membership and weekly hours. A new Certification entity would reference an employee.
sections.note: Both are proposed; the sketch also labels the new entity unsupported by today’s adapter. These declarations do not add derived attributes or new platform entities through this site.
sections.source:
(derive Placement union_covered
  (Boolean :label "Covered by the agreement" :cites (clause cba "art-3.1"))
  (all (neq Placement.union_local :none)
       (gte Placement.weekly_hours 20)))

; [proposed] [unsupported] A new entity type, for a future runtime.
(entity Certification
  {:holder     (Ref Employee :cardinality :one)
   :kind       (Enum CertificationKind :label "Kind")
   :expires_on (Date :label "Expires on")})

sections.title: Forms
sections.summary: Three local forms, plus a W-4 reference to another package. Union card has employee and employer pages and Spanish text.
sections.note: dues-rate is build-time math; f/round is a runtime formula. The form’s 30-day release option is proposed, so the reminder/story depends on a release binding that does not exist here.
sections.source:
(define dues-percent 1.5)
(define dues-rate (/ dues-percent 100))

(form union-card "Union card"
  :locales [:en :es]
  :reads [Job.hourly_rate Placement.weekly_hours]
  :release {:task-due-in-days 30}   ; [proposed] lineage intent; today in releases/*.release.json
  :pages
    [(page "Union membership" {:assignee :employee}
       [(checkbox has-card
          {:label "I already hold a union card"
           :i18n {:es {:label "Ya tengo una tarjeta sindical"}}})
        (text Employee.union_card_number
          {:label "Union card number" :required true
           :rule (show (eq has-card true))})
        (address Employee.mailing_address {:label "Mailing address" :required true})
        ; Runtime math: renders to one =ROUND(...) spreadsheet formula, with the build-time
        ; dues-rate inlined as 0.015.
        (formula weekly-dues
          {:label (str "Estimated weekly dues (" dues-percent "% of gross)")
           :value (f/round (f/* (f/val Job.hourly_rate)
                                (f/val Placement.weekly_hours)
                                dues-rate)
                           2)})
        (sign-here :employee_signature)])
     (page "Steward review" {:assignee :employer}
       [(review (answer :steward_review Review)
          {:label "Review" :rows [Employee.union_card_number weekly-dues]})
        (sign-here :steward_signature)])])

sections.title: Policies
sections.summary: An explicit applies-when rule selects a policy, and a form-when rule makes the drug-screen consent conditional.
sections.note: The other policy reads a proposed derived union_covered attribute. The target IR would lower policies to purpose=policy automations; the local ontology runtime does not do this.
sections.source:
(policy warehouse-onboarding
  :name "Warehouse onboarding"
  :applies-when at-warehouse
  :requires [w4
             site-safety
             (form-when drug-screen-consent (eq Client.requires_drug_screen true))])

sections.title: Automations
sections.summary: A task-triggered reminder waits until two days after its due date, then emails if still open. A placement-triggered flow can assign site safety.
sections.note: Trigger fact scopes differ: the task-triggered flow cannot read placement custom attributes. Email templates need a target-supplied parameter; nothing here sends email or runs a wait.
sections.source:
(automation union-card-reminder
  :name "Union card reminder"
  :trigger (on-task :form union-card :events [:created])   ; lowers to a first condition on form.id
  :rerun :restart_on_trigger
  :flow
    [(wait :two_days_after_due {:days 2 :after :task_due})
     (condition :still_open (neq Task.status "completed")
       {:yes [(send-email :remind_employee
                {:to :employee
                 :template overdue-template
                 :subject "Your union card is overdue"
                 :body "Hi {{ employee.first_name }}, please complete your union card."})]})])

sections.title: Access
sections.summary: The West managers group reads Client.region, declared as a permission-scope property. Job.site_type is searchable but not in that scope.
sections.note: A proposed scope checker would reject a read of Job.site_type here. Type.member paths, slash keywords, and type metadata still need verification against Forma.

sections.title: Integration
sections.summary: Bind a provider revision, contract, and account-resolved connection reference. Credentials stay with the target account.
sections.note: This is configuration intent, not a provider connection or an integration supported by this package.
sections.source:
(integration checkr
  :provider "@onboarded-platform/checkr"
  :revision "1.4.0"
  :contract 1
  :connection "checkr"   ; a reference the target resolves; never a credential
  :settings {:package "driver_pro" :adjudication :manual})

sections.title: Journeys
sections.summary: Placement cases state policy and form expectations; automation runs describe branches; a story describes progress over time.
sections.note: These are authored expectations, not executed results. The ten-day completion story depends on the proposed 30-day release option.
sections.source:
(placement "union local not recorded yet"
    :policy-evaluation :three_state
    (given Job.site_type :office)
    (given Placement.weekly_hours 32)
    (expect-policies)
    (expect-forms)
    (expect-outcome union-card-obligation :unknown
      :missing [Placement.union_local]
      :forms [(form-outcome union-card :unknown :missing [Placement.union_local])])))
